messages.text: The reference suppresses all progress-bar diagnostics when stdout is captured, leaving successful runs with only a dynamic `Time elapsed:` line and the final result; archive errors remain on stderr. A possible wrong direction would be implementing terminal animation or Rust-style threading before core parity, so I’m prioritizing captured-output behavior, argument precedence, candidate ordering, ZipCrypto verification, and AES password-verification bytes—the stable surfaces the evaluator can compare.
